# OBS control

One browser source in OBS — the rig page — plays the bot's voice and the sound alerts into your stream, draws the bot's avatar, switches scenes on request and pauses the timer on a scene. It connects out from OBS, so it works from any network. Off: the rig page is refused and nothing reaches OBS.

This is a module: switch it on during setup (the **Modules** page) or later in the Admin Panel → Site → Modules — it is off on a new install. Its setup page then appears with the steps below.

The addresses below are for a site at `example.com`; your setup page shows your own.

## 1. Add the rig page to OBS

In OBS: Sources → + → Browser. Paste the rig page address from Admin Panel → Utility → OBS (it carries this site's key — keep it private), width 1920, height 1080. Tick "Control audio via OBS" so the voice and sounds reach your stream. For scene switching, set "Page permissions" to "Advanced access to OBS". Put the source in every scene you stream from (or in a scene you nest into each). Nothing is installed on your computer.

Links:

- [OBS: browser sources](https://obsproject.com/kb/browser-source)

## 2. Pause the timer on a scene (optional)

The stream timer pauses while OBS shows this scene (a break scene, say) and plays on any other. The rig page tells the site which scene is on, so its page permission must be at least "Read access to user information". Type the name exactly as OBS shows it.

This step fills:

- **Timer pause scene**. The stream timer pauses while OBS shows this scene and plays on any other. Unset = scene changes never pause or play the timer.

You can skip this step and come back to it from the Admin Panel.
